theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_coarea_eilenberg
theorems.statement: ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (A : Set (Eucl P)), LipschitzOnWith L f A → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ φ t) ∧ ∫⁻ t, φ t ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * (L : ℝ≥0∞) * (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) A
